name: Solvei
title: Enchantress of the Arcanum
examine: Ink on her fingers, frost in her hair that isn't age, and the particular stillness of somebody listening to something you can't hear.
lines: Runes burn brighter at altitude. Nobody knows why. I have four theories and a burn mark for each.
I petitioned eleven years for the seal to open. Now it's open, and I find my sleep has opinions about what I asked for.
The Riftgate below hums in a key I almost recognize. Almost is the most important word in my profession.
